description: Bob Fioretti’s legal career spans over three decades of advocating for justice in both the courtroom and the community. As Senior Supervising Attorney in the General Litigation Division under Mayor Harold Washington, Bob supervised more than 500 civil rights cases and personally tried over 100 cases that influenced state and federal law.
